description: This file defines an abstract class 'HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache' for managing cache storage of definitions within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes method signatures and some implemented logic for key generation, cache validation, and type checking but lacks concrete implementations, indicating it's intended to be extended by subclasses.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache
classes.description: Abstract base class providing common cache management methods for HTMLPurifier definitions, including key generation, type checking, and cache validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache with a specific definition type.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Creates a unique cache key based on configuration properties.

methods.name: isOld
methods.description: Determines if a cache key is outdated with respect to the current configuration.

methods.name: checkDefType
methods.description: Validates that a definition object's type matches the cache type.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Abstract method for adding a definition to the cache.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Abstract method for unconditionally saving a definition to the cache.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Abstract method for replacing an existing cache entry with a new definition.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Abstract method for retrieving a definition from the cache based on current configuration.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Abstract method for removing cache entries based on configuration.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Abstract method for clearing all cache entries.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Abstract method for removing expired or outdated cache entries.
